about: Where a caster's spell leaves its hands (MapStage castHandsShare): per unit (catalog key) and the pose shown when the spell lets go, the height of the hands / the spell's glow as a share of the card's height from the feet (0 = feet, 1 = top of the image). In place of the body's middle (0.45, the hip: the user, 2026-11-25: "parece que ele esta mijando a magia", "porra como sai sempre tudo a virilha porra acerta as alturas"). Measured from the art: "cast" = the centroid of the spell's glow over the frames of the cast pose (Voss violet, Isolde red; Aldric the thrusting hand), "castBack" = the hands on the back still (after the turn: "ele vira e solta"). A spell only: weapon skills keep their own ("habilidades de espada não são magias").
